## Working session summary

PR 2131 is finalized and ready for review: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2131

**Final state**

- Local: `npm test` 372/372 pass (`TEST_EXIT=0`), `npm run lint` clean, `npm run format:check` clean.
- CI: run `30766367199` on `55b30c8a` **completed success**. The prior failure on `1c106b11` was the "Check for Changesets" job, resolved by adding `.changeset/formal-ai-direct-endpoint.md`.
- Working tree clean; `origin/main` fully merged; no unaddressed comments on the issue or the PR.
- Self-review of the full 2054-line `src` diff found no defects.

**What the PR delivers against the issue's ten requirements**

- **R3/R4** — Hive Mind no longer invokes CLIs through the `formal-ai with` argv wrapper. It starts `formal-ai serve --agent-mode` and points each native CLI at that endpoint via its own config channel (`CODEX_HOME`, `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH`, `OPENAI_MODEL`, provider env). New `src/formal-ai-runtime.lib.mjs`.
- **R1** — Four false positives/negatives and two errors fixed, each traced to a quoted line in the stored logs (session-summary false negative, per-run codex `WARNING`, expected 404 as error, `gh auth setup-git` on a bind-mounted `~/.gitconfig`, wrong `codex login` remedy).
- **R10** — The quiet-probe idiom applied to all 20 affected modules, guarded by a repo-wide static test. This also stopped `gh auth status --show-token` from printing a live credential into the log uploaded by `--attach-logs`.
- **R9** — Wrapper version recorded on both paths; runtime logs endpoint/protocol/config root/env; codex diagnostics extracted as unit-testable pure functions.
- **R2** — Eight upstream issues filed (formal-ai #902–#909), each with a committed reproduction.
- **R5/R6/R7/R8** — Case study in `docs/case-studies/issue-2130` with 30 GitHub captures, 7 solver logs, and every experiment's output.

One correction worth flagging, since it changed a conclusion I had previously published: the claim that `agent` hung on the injected `--interactive` was wrong. `agent` 0.25.5 exits 0 in 4 s on closed piped stdin either way; the 18 restarts were Hive Mind's own auto-restart-until-mergeable feature reacting to a run that produced nothing. I recorded that negative result in §6.8 and posted the correction to formal-ai#903 rather than leaving an overstated severity upstream. No `link-assistant/agent` filing is warranted.
